scope: Institutional stakeholder reports from 20 original catchment communiqués; original passages and participant data excluded.
location_policy: All 375 named records are catchment-level reports. LGA names, when included, are source-text location hints requiring GIS matching, not precise site coordinates.
asset_policy: Water and dam references may concern existing, proposed or failed facilities; no completed-infrastructure determination is implied.
source_notice: Source statements are stakeholder-reported and have not been independently surveyed or revalidated. Resource mention counts are NOT abundance, production or exact site counts.
